name: PM SVANidhi
amount: ₹15,000 first loan; ₹25,000 second; ₹50,000 third (enhanced 2025; scheme extended to March 2030)
docs: Vending certificate or letter of recommendation from ULB/TVC
docs_hi: वेंडिंग सर्टिफिकेट या ULB/TVC से अनुशंसा पत्र
notes: Collateral-free. 7% interest subsidy. Digital cashback on transactions.

name: PM MUDRA - Shishu
for: Micro businesses, shops, service units needing up to ₹50,000
docs: Business proof or plan (quotation of machinery/items)
notes: No collateral. Interest depends on lender (usually 9-12%).

name: PM MUDRA - Kishore
for: Growing micro businesses needing ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh
for_hi: बढ़ते छोटे कारोबार - ₹50,001 से ₹5 लाख तक
notes: Collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh under CGTMSE cover.

name: PM MUDRA - Tarun
for: Established micro businesses needing ₹5 lakh to ₹20 lakh
for_hi: स्थापित छोटे व्यवसाय - ₹5 लाख से ₹20 लाख तक
amount: ₹5,00,001 to ₹20,00,000 (limit raised from ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh in Budget 2024)
notes: Collateral-free up to ₹10 lakh under CGTMSE cover.

name: Kisan Credit Card
for: Farmers - crop loans and allied activities
for_hi: किसान - फसल और संबद्ध गतिविधियों के लिए
amount: based on landholding and crop; typically ₹50,000 to ₹3 lakh
amount_hi: ज़मीन और फसल के हिसाब से; आमतौर पर ₹50,000 से ₹3 लाख
apply: Any public/private bank, cooperative bank, or PM-KISAN portal linkage
notes: 4% effective interest on prompt repayment (7% - 3% subvention) up to ₹3 lakh.

name: SHG - Bank Linkage (DAY-NRLM)
for: Women in rural areas - join a self-help group for savings + credit
for_hi: ग्रामीण महिलाएं - स्वयं सहायता समूह से बचत और लोन
amount: Group-linked; individual share commonly ₹30,000 to ₹1 lakh over cycles
amount_hi: समूह के माध्यम से; चक्रों में ₹30,000 से ₹1 लाख तक
docs: SHG membership (or form a new group of 10-15 women)
docs_hi: समूह की सदस्यता (या 10-15 महिलाओं का नया समूह)
apply: Block office / Mission Shakti / nearest bank
notes: Builds credit history as a group; 7% interest, additional subvention in 250 districts.

name: Stand-Up India
for: Women or SC/ST entrepreneurs starting a NEW enterprise (₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore)
for_hi: महिला या SC/ST उद्यमी - नया कारोबार (₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़)

name: Jan Dhan overdraft
for: Jan Dhan account holders needing small emergency credit
for_hi: जन धन खाताधारक - छोटी ज़रूरत के लिए
docs: Jan Dhan account with 6 months satisfactory operation
apply: Your bank branch where the Jan Dhan account is
notes: Small but instant; builds a credit footprint.
